scientific_integrity: The classification is proved algebraically and checked by a standalone exact-arithmetic exhaustive verifier; prior literature is compared explicitly, with publication-priority and limited-access risks stated. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the unweighted four-dimensional hypercube, independent vertex-coordinate actuation and ordinary Laplacian Kalman controllability; no general higher-dimensional, weighted-edge, energy, or robustness claim. The exact orbit classification is a finite exhaustive computation with rational-equivalent modular arithmetic.
title: Exact minimum-coordinate controllability on the four-cube: an antipodal parity rule and eight symmetry types
